anchors.sim_min.note: Anchors: each anchor's SIM to the centroid of the others, both embedders, else exit 3. H6 calibrates [E].

retrieval.anchor_floor.note: Retrieval: median SIM a cluster needs to the anchor centroid to be primary or flagged. H6 calibrates [E].

retrieval.margin.note: Retrieval: a turn's SIM to the target over its SIM to every non-admitted cluster, both embedders. H6 calibrates [E].

retrieval.loo_percentile.note: Retrieval: a kept turn is at or above this percentile of the leave-one-out distribution. Fixed.

segment.min_s.note: Segment: shortest segment of the short set, seconds. Fixed.

segment.max_s.note: Segment: longest segment of the short set, seconds. Fixed.

segment.long_min_s.note: Segment: shortest segment of the long-line set, seconds. Fixed.

segment.long_max_s.note: Segment: longest segment of the long-line set, seconds. Fixed.

segment.overlap_max_ms.note: Segment: overlapped speech allowed, milliseconds. Fixed.

segment.snr_min_db.note: Segment: minimum SNR, dB. H6 calibrates [E].

segment.c50_min_db.note: Segment: minimum C50, dB. H6 calibrates [E].

segment.window_s.note: Segment: window length of the window check, seconds. Fixed.

segment.window_percentile.note: Segment: every window at or above this percentile of the window distribution. H6 calibrates [E].

cleaning.sim_percentile.note: Cleaning step: median SIM(output, input) at or above this percentile (the median) of the distribution, both embedders (VC-039). Fixed.

cleaning.spectrum_max_db.note: Cleaning step: largest spectrum distance between output and input, dB. H6 calibrates [E].

ingest.bandwidth_cutoff_db.note: Ingest (T5): effective bandwidth is the highest frequency above which the voiced long-term spectrum stays this many dB below its 1-4 kHz mean. H6 calibrates [E].

seed.sample_rate_min_hz.note: Seed: lowest source sample rate, Hz. Fixed.

seed.rehearsal_precision_min.note: Seed: the rehearsal's extraction precision needed at the same thresholds. Fixed.

seed.purity_percentile.note: Seed: purity is this percentile of kept segments' margin over the nearest other cluster (reported). Fixed.

seed.state_seconds_min.note: Seed: a state with fewer seconds is flagged for state-prompted teachers or conversion. Fixed.

state_floor.percentile.note: State floor: the percentile a floor is taken at. Fixed.

state_floor.own_n_min.note: State floor: confirmed segments needed for the state's own floor. Fixed.

state_floor.thin_n_min.note: State floor: below this, the pooled floor minus the state's offset applies. Fixed.

state_floor.offset.neutral.note: State floor: neutral's offset below the pooled p10 when it has under 5 segments. H6 calibrates [E].

state_floor.offset.calm.note: State floor: calm's offset below the pooled p10 when it has under 5 segments. H6 calibrates [E].

state_floor.offset.awake.note: State floor: awake's offset below the pooled p10 when it has under 5 segments. H6 calibrates [E].

state_floor.offset.sleepy.note: State floor: sleepy's offset below the pooled p10 when it has under 5 segments. H6 calibrates [E].

state_floor.offset.excited.note: State floor: excited's offset below the pooled p10 when it has under 5 segments. H6 calibrates [E].

state_floor.identity_windows_min.note: State floor: identity-mode windows needed before the rehearsal floor stops applying. Fixed.

state_floor.rehearsal_identity_window_fl.note: State floor: the floor identity mode uses under 20 windows, measured on the rehearsal. H6 calibrates [E].

take.cer_max.note: Take (VC-044): highest CER of a kept take. Fixed.

take.n.note: Take: takes per line and state (best-of-N). Fixed.

take.n.calm.note: Take: takes per line for calm. Fixed.

take.n.sleepy.note: Take: takes per line for sleepy. Fixed.

take.rounds_max.note: Take: generation rounds per line and state. Fixed.

bakeoff.weak_rating_below.note: Bake-off: a state is weak when its chosen teacher's mean feeling rating (of 5) is below this. H6 calibrates [E].

bakeoff.pass_fraction_min.note: Bake-off: a state is weak when fewer than this share of its teacher's takes pass the take gate. Fixed.

text.sample_n.note: Text sample: lines Raj reviews per state. Fixed.

text.reject_max.note: Text sample: a state's lines pass with at most this many rejected. H6 calibrates [E].

spotcheck.sample_n.note: Spot check: takes Raj reviews per state. Fixed.

spotcheck.reject_max.note: Spot check: a batch is accepted with at most this many rejected per state. H6 calibrates [E].

bench.first_audio_cpu_ms_max.note: Bench (4.2): median first audio on the CPU path, ms, idle and under E4B decode. Fixed.

bench.first_audio_gpu_stt_ms_max.note: Bench (4.2): median first audio with GPU STT, ms. Fixed.

bench.decode_loss_max.note: Bench (4.2): largest E4B decode loss, as a fraction. Fixed.

bench.sim_median_ratio_min.note: Bench (4.2): median SIM per state over the distribution's median. Fixed.

bench.f0_std_tolerance.note: Bench (4.2): F0 standard deviation within this fraction of the seed's, per state. Fixed.
